"""Blank body and page-band paragraphs share font, spacing and measurement."""

from io import BytesIO

import pymupdf
import pytest
from docx import Document as WordDocument
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.shared import Pt

from aspose.words_foss import Document
from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer import LdmPdfWriter
from aspose.words_foss.pdf_writer.constants import PT_TO_MM


def marker(text):
    return ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.Run(text=text, font=ldm.Font(size=8))])


def model_for(blank, location):
    children = [marker("START"), blank, marker("END")]
    section = ldm.Section(
        page_setup=ldm.PageSetup(
            page_width=300,
            page_height=400,
            left_margin=20,
            right_margin=20,
            top_margin=100,
            bottom_margin=100,
            header_distance=20,
            footer_distance=20,
        ),
        body=ldm.Body(children=children if location == "body" else [marker("BODY")]),
    )
    if location != "body":
        section.headers_footers = [
            ldm.HeaderFooter(
                header_footer_type=0 if location == "header" else 1,
                children=children,
            )
        ]
    return ldm.Document(sections=[section])


def marker_distance(raw):
    with pymupdf.open(stream=raw, filetype="pdf") as pdf:
        assert len(pdf) == 1
        words = {word[4]: word for word in pdf[0].get_text("words")}
        return words["END"][1] - words["START"][1]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("location", ["body", "header", "footer"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("size", [8, 30])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("rule,spacing", [(2, 0), (1, 20), (0, 30), (2, 24)])
def test_empty_story_uses_mark_font_spacing_and_shared_measurement(
    location, size, rule, spacing
):
    blank = ldm.Paragraph(
        paragraph_format=ldm.ParagraphFormat(
            paragraph_break_font=ldm.Font(size=size),
            line_spacing_rule=rule,
            line_spacing=spacing,
            space_before=3,
            space_after=7,
        )
    )
    model = model_for(blank, location)
    original = model.model_dump_json()
    expected = size * 1.4
    if rule == 1:
        expected = spacing
    elif rule == 0:
        expected = max(expected, spacing)
    elif spacing:
        expected *= spacing / 12
    expected += 10
    writer = LdmPdfWriter()
    distance = marker_distance(writer.write_to_bytes(model))
    assert distance == pytest.approx(11.2 + expected, abs=0.03)
    assert writer._estimate_paragraph_height(blank, 260 * PT_TO_MM) == pytest.approx(
        expected * PT_TO_MM, abs=0.01
    )
    assert model.model_dump_json() == original


@pytest.mark.parametrize("location", ["body", "header", "footer"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("size", [8, 30])
def test_public_docx_blank_mark_reaches_body_and_page_bands(location, size):
    source = WordDocument()
    section = source.sections[0]
    section.page_width, section.page_height = Pt(300), Pt(400)
    section.top_margin = section.bottom_margin = Pt(100)
    section.left_margin = section.right_margin = Pt(20)
    section.header_distance = section.footer_distance = Pt(20)
    if location == "body":
        first = source.add_paragraph()
        blank = source.add_paragraph()
        last = source.add_paragraph()
    else:
        source.add_paragraph("BODY")
        story = getattr(section, location)
        first, blank, last = (
            story.paragraphs[0],
            story.add_paragraph(),
            story.add_paragraph(),
        )
    for paragraph in [first, blank, last]:
        paragraph.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        paragraph.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
        paragraph.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.0
    first.add_run("START").font.size = Pt(8)
    last.add_run("END").font.size = Pt(8)
    properties = OxmlElement("w:rPr")
    font_size = OxmlElement("w:sz")
    font_size.set(qn("w:val"), str(size * 2))
    properties.append(font_size)
    blank._p.get_or_add_pPr().append(properties)
    stream = BytesIO()
    source.save(stream)
    document = Document(BytesIO(stream.getvalue()))
    assert marker_distance(document.to_bytes("pdf")) == pytest.approx(
        11.2 + size * 1.4, abs=0.03
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("run_size,expected", [(8, 11.2), (0, 42)])
def test_whitespace_run_size_keeps_existing_precedence_over_mark(run_size, expected):
    blank = ldm.Paragraph(
        paragraph_format=ldm.ParagraphFormat(paragraph_break_font=ldm.Font(size=30)),
        children=[ldm.Run(text=" ", font=ldm.Font(size=run_size))],
    )
    model = model_for(blank, "body")
    assert marker_distance(LdmPdfWriter().write_to_bytes(model)) == pytest.approx(
        11.2 + expected, abs=0.03
    )
